_note: Key order is the pack order and is generated into src/string_ids.h. Add keys at the end; never reorder or delete without rebuilding every language. %1..%4 are the slots the firmware fills, and a translation may put them in any order.

strings.UI_HELP3_1: Hold the deck to shuffle. Your touch feeds the draw, on top of the chip's hardware noise.
strings.UI_HELP3_2: Release to cut. Three cards are dealt: past, present, future.
strings.UI_HELP3_3: Tap a card to turn it. Tap it again to read it.
strings.UI_HELP3_4: BOOT steps through the cards. Press BOOT and PWR together, or hold BOOT, to close the reading.
strings.UI_HELP3_5: PWR opens the inner reading: how the three cards speak to each other.
strings.UI_HELP1_1: Touch the deck to pick a card. Your touch feeds the draw, on top of the chip's hardware noise.
strings.UI_HELP1_2: The card arrives face down and turns itself over.
strings.UI_HELP1_3: Tap it to read what it means. Tap again to send it back to the deck.
strings.UI_HELP1_4: BOOT and PWR together, or hold BOOT, closes the reading at any point.
strings.UI_HELP1_5: Settings switches between one card and three.
strings.UI_TAP_THE_CARD: TAP THE CARD TO TURN IT
strings.UI_TAP_A_CARD: TAP A CARD TO TURN IT
